reviews.review:
It's a small, but very fun and charming game. There's plenty of different tracks, so there's a good variety in that regard. The tracks also feel fun. The racing speed is good as well.  Its not too fast, nor too slow. Good pacing. The music is nice as well.

If you find yourself last, bonus pick-up items are always useful. They drives you fast to catch up with the rest. If you're first, you get only bombs and ice freezing items to slow down your opponents behind. Not the greatest idea, but it works. Some of the pick-up items are unique for the genre (at least I haven't seen in other games). Like the ability to clean other fruits juice that slows you down. 

Perhaps the major downside is that once you beat the game, there's not much else to do except drive with different fruits and experience different tracks you haven't played yet. I think after winning a cup, you even unlock some things, but I'm not sure yet what are those. There's lack of options as well.

Overall, the game is Ideal for short 15-20 minutes of relaxing sessions. Would've been even bettr, if there were more things to do.
